description: The bar chart illustrates the relationship between the number of shots and the ratio of gamma to B, comparing incorrect and correct responses. The horizontal axis represents the number of shots, labeled from 0 to 4 in integer increments, while the vertical axis is labeled as γ/B with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.6 in intervals of 0.2. The chart features grouped bars, with each group representing a specific number of shots and containing two bars: one for incorrect responses (blue with black dots) and one for correct responses (red with diagonal lines). The height of the bars for incorrect responses decreases as the number of shots increases, from approximately 0.4 at 0 shots to around 0.3 at 4 shots. In contrast, the bars for correct responses are consistently taller than those for incorrect responses, starting at around 0.7 at 0 shots and decreasing to approximately 0.45 at 4 shots. The bars are grouped by the number of shots, with the incorrect and correct bars positioned side by side for each category. The chart does not display any specific sorting or visual emphasis on particular bars.
